personal-assistant.title: Android always-on (M1b): foreground mic service, lifecycle, focus, keep-screen-on, kiosk join
personal-assistant.body:
## Problem
The spec's Milestone 1b (foreground mic service, keep-screen-on, launcher, boot) never shipped. Once the activity is backgrounded, screen-off or dozed, Android delivers silence into `AudioRecord` with no error and no stream end, so the restart backoff cannot help: the wall goes deaf. A reminder that fires while the socket is down is deferred to the next launch.

unwritten-chronicles.title: Real notification system
unwritten-chronicles.body: A real app has notifications beyond the browser. We could have a email/sms system so they can get a what did you miss while your away. Turn off able.

unwritten-chronicles.title: Improve lock and unlock system, invite user
unwritten-chronicles.body: We have a lock and unlock system. It's fine, but an invite user by email would be much simpler and bullet proof in malicious actors. Leaving the locking mechanism allows admins to run it how they want, but giving folks the option to invite by email removes friction and stops malicious actors waiting for opportunity.

unwritten-chronicles.title: Bookmark system
unwritten-chronicles.body: We want players to be able to share moments that happen with the players. I think a bookmark button on the game messages would be cool. Then we can open the bookmark menu and see a list of recent bookmarks, click them to visit that point in the log.
